# Pingram Node SDK (Server-side)

[![npm version](https://badge.fury.io/js/pingram.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pingram)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

A fully-typed TypeScript SDK for Pingram (formerly NotificationAPI).

## Installation

### Production (latest stable)

```bash
npm install pingram
```

## Usage

### Basic Setup

Import and initialize the client:

```typescript
import { Pingram } from 'pingram';

// Server-side: Secret Key (Bearer token)
const apiClient = new Pingram({
  apiKey: 'pingram_sk_...'
});
```

For connecting to Canada or EU regions, set the region option:

```typescript
const apiClient = new Pingram({
  apiKey: 'pingram_sk_...',
  region: 'eu'
});
```

### Send

```typescript
await apiClient.send({
  type: 'otp',
  to: {
    id: 'user123',
    email: 'user@example.com',
    number: '+15005550006'
  },
  email: {
    subject: 'Hello',
    html: '<h1>Hello, world!</h1>'
  },
  sms: {
    message: 'Hello, world!'
  }
});
```
